summary: Dream Interpreter bug fix VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: POST /api/dreams/interpret now returns 200 with substantial interpretation (>400 chars) after upgrade from deprecated gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash. Both full-input and empty-description cases pass. Sanity check on POST /api/spirit-guides/chat (elemental guide, also LLM-backed) also returns 200 — related routes are healthy. Frontend: logged in as admin (captcha solved), navigated to /dreams, submitted a dream description, and observed the interpretation render in the UI with a Save-to-Journal CTA. No 500s, no 'Failed to interpret' alerts.

react_native_issues.issue: Missing testID on all interactive elements (email input, password input, captcha input, Sign In button, dream description TextInput, Interpret My Dream button, Save to Journal button). Had to fall back to text/coordinate-based selectors for automation. Reference: /app/frontend/app/auth/login.tsx and /app/frontend/app/dreams.tsx

Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated (use textShadow), props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Not blocking, but should be migrated. Reference: multiple screens (observed on /auth/login and /dreams).
Repeated warning: 'No route named "files" exists in nested children'. A drawer/layout entry references a non-existent route named 'files'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx (or drawer layout).

action_items: Optional: add testID attributes to auth-login (email-input, password-input, captcha-input, sign-in-button) and dreams (dream-description-input, interpret-button, save-to-journal-button) to make future automation deterministic.
Optional cleanup: remove non-existent 'files' route from layout, migrate shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents style props to their modern equivalents to silence console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/dreams.py:87-89 — the exception handler swallows the real error and returns a generic 'Failed to interpret dream'. Consider including a debug ID or exposing the actual class name in dev logs (already logged, but no correlation ID returned to client). Not blocking.

/app/frontend/app/dreams.tsx:107-118 — endpoint call attaches a Bearer token but the backend endpoint has no auth guard; anonymous requests succeed. Intentional? If dreams should require login, add auth guard on the FastAPI route.
No file-size / DRY concerns for the fixed files. dreams.tsx is 776 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting the modal + save-flow into a sub-component.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: Google deprecated the gemini-2.0-flash model. Backend calls via LlmChat.with_model('gemini', 'gemini-2.0-flash') raised litellm.NotFoundError which the FastAPI handler converted to HTTP 500 with body {'detail':'Failed to interpret dream'}. Reproduction (pre-fix): POST /api/dreams/interpret with any body → 500. Mitigation applied by main agent: upgraded model string to 'gemini-2.5-flash' in dreams.py, community.py, admin.py, meditation.py, spirit_guides.py, and services/contest_service.py. Verified: 200 OK with full interpretation payload (~1400+ chars) and success:true. UI renders the interpretation and shows Save-to-Journal CTA.
